scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run the full MD simulations nor recompute the average defect counts from raw per-cascade data (only aggregated averages are provided). The main claims of monotonic increase with energy/temperature and interfacial peak can be verified as structural properties from the output artifacts.

outputs.description: Averaged Wigner-Seitz defect counts per cascade for each combination of cell type, recoil energy, and temperature.
Radial yield density profiles of defects for the Fe₃C inclusion cell.

output_contract.notes: The scored outputs are evaluated by structural audit and statistical checks.

steps.description: Check monotonic increase of defect counts with energy and temperature, and vacancy=interstitial equality.
